options.name: bs
options.description: Set input and output block size

options.name: files
options.description: Copy this many files before terminating

options.name: if
options.description: Read an input file instead of stdin

options.name: iseek
options.description: Seek this many blocks on the input file

options.name: of
options.description: Write to an output file instead of stdout

options.name: oseek
options.description: Seek this many blocks on the output file

options.name: seek
options.description: Seek this many blocks from the beginning of the output before copying

options.name: skip
options.description: Skip this many blocks from the beginning of the input before copying
